subject: Rate alignment and SOW extension request — ACME Health
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Rate alignment and SOW extension request — ACME Health

Tom — following up from last week's call. ACME is asking for: (1) an additional 300k token/ month capacity burst for Q4, and (2) a 9-month extension to the current SOW to cover pilot expansion across two more clinics. To accommodate that we need to: adjust the order form fee schedule (one-time capacity add + new monthly run-rate) and go through a quick legal review on a couple of redline items (price escalation clause, termination-for-convenience language for the added capacity, and an updated audit clause).

I attached a draft OrderForm_v2 with the proposed fee table and a marked-up SOW page (see attachment names below). Can we get legal eyes on the redlines today so we can respond to procurement by Thursday? Karthik — can you confirm the recommended effective date we should propose (EOD 10/1)? David, please flag any infra compatibility blockers for the capacity burst.

Attachments: OrderForm_v2.pdf (pdf), SOW_Q4_extension_excerpt.docx (docx)

Thanks,
— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rate alignment and SOW extension request — ACME Health

Agree we should move fast. Quick notes from pricing side: 
- Recommend effective date of 2026-10-01 (aligns to their Q4 budget).
- Proposed capacity add: one-time top-up fee $18,000 for the 300k token buffer + $6,500/mo incremental run-rate thereafter.
- For the SOW extension, prefer a fixed 9-month term with an opt-in for renewal at quarter-end.

Marissa — can you review the attached order form and advise on whether the price-escalation language (index + 3%) is acceptable, or whether we should cap it?

David — if we can support burst immediately, flag any warm-up windows or provisioning lead times.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rate alignment and SOW extension request — ACME Health

Thanks for the packet. I pulled a quick redline and have three priority asks before we hand to procurement: 
1) Escalation cap — the proposed "CPI + 3%" is broad; request we cap escalation at 5% annually (with earlier of CPI or published index to prevent negative adjustments).
2) Termination / capacity unwind — we need explicit language that any one-time top-up is non-refundable but that we will prorate ongoing run-rate for early termination; add a 60-day notice for capacity downsizes.
3) Audit & Data Access — refine the audit clause to limit queries to frequency not exceeding once per 12 months and require redacted logs where PII could be implicated.

I attached a tracked redline (MSA_Redline_Sep15.docx) and inline comments in the OrderForm_v2.pdf. Also: we should avoid inserting broad indemnity language in the order form; keep indemnities in the MSA.

Next steps I propose: 
- Sales to propose the 5% cap option to ACME and ask if they will accept 10/1 effective date.
- If ACME insists on uncapped escalation, escalate to legal for the head of contracts.

Attaching: MSA_Redline_Sep15.docx (docx), OrderForm_v2.pdf (pdf)

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, Andres Molina <andres.molina@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 10:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rate alignment and SOW extension request — ACME Health

Soojin / team — thanks for the package. A few items from procurement and our legal: 
- We like the one-time top-up approach. Can you confirm the one-time fee is invoiced on signature?
- Regarding escalation: ACME can't accept a hard 5% cap unless there is an explicit CPI floor; would you consider CPI floor 0%, cap at CPI + 4%, or alternatively CPI + 2% with a 6-month fixed rate for the pilot period?
- Effective date: we can do 10/1 if the order form is signed by 9/24. Can Redwood commit to that timeline?

I've attached our PO draft (ACME_PO_9987.pdf) for reference — procurement wants to include a short appendix referencing the token add.

If you can send a revised mark with the two escalation options and the invoicing language, procurement can sign off quickly.

Thanks,
Tom Alvarez
Director, Strategic Programs — ACME Health
Tom.Alvarez@acmehealth.com | +1 617-555-0456

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rate alignment and SOW extension request — ACME Health

Tom — appreciate the quick review and the PO. Yes — one-time top-up invoiced on signature. Timeline: we can target 9/24 for signature if legal sign-off is complete by 9/22. 

Per Marissa's asks, we'll propose two escalation paths for ACME to choose from: 
A) CPI + 2% with a 6-month fixed pilot rate (then back to CPI + 2% thereafter)
B) CPI with a 4% annual cap (no floor)

We will also include the invoicing clause (invoice on signature) and the capacity-proration language Marissa suggested. David confirms the platform can support the 300k token burst with a 48-hour warm-up window — no infra blockers.

Next steps: 
- I will upload a revised OrderForm_v3 with the two escalation options and the invoicing sentence into the shared Drive folder and include a tracked change for Marissa to final sign-off.
- Marissa — if you can give final go/no-go on the cap wording by Friday (9/18), procurement can sign the PO after we insert the appendix.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Aexample-orderform
DocuSign (if ready): https://docusign.net/signing/xyz789

Thanks — Soojin

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rate alignment and SOW extension request — ACME Health

Soojin / team — quick final: I prefer option A for the pilot (CPI + 2% with 6-month fixed pilot) because it provides price predictability for ACME while protecting Redwood from runaway inflation. I added clean language for the invoicing ("One-time capacity top-up shall be invoiced upon signature and payable within thirty (30) days") and a short clause for capacity proration on early termination. Please apply the attached snippet to OrderForm_v3 and route to Procurement. 

If procurement pushes on cap, we can accept a compromise of CPI + 2% with a 4% hard cap but that would need exec approval. 

Attaching: Final_Snippet_Invoicing.txt (txt)

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
